name: video-starter-kit
description: AI-powered video studio built with Next.js 14, Remotion, and fal.ai. Browser-native video composition with timeline editor, multi-track support, and 20+ AI models for image, video, music, and voiceover generation. IndexedDB auto-save, optional file upload (UploadThing) and sharing (Upstash KV).
author: fal-ai-community

stack.ai: fal.ai (Flux, Minimax, Hunyuan, Kling, Luma, LTX, Veo2, MMAudio, PlayHT, PlayAI, F5-TTS, Stable Audio, Topaz)

install.step2: Fill in .env with FAL_KEY (get from https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys)
install.step3: npm run dev  # starts at http://localhost:3000

security_review.notes: Standard Next.js 14 app. No eval(), no child_process, no shell exec. fal.ai proxy at /api/fal (server-side). Remotion for browser-native video rendering. IndexedDB via idb. .env.example has empty placeholders only.
